_: The interface's finesse pass (docs/review/ui-pass.md; ui.gd reads it through data.gd). The camera pad shows only when the player picks 'always' in Settings (else the camera moves by mouse, trackpad and keys) and the minimap sits flush to the right edge; the date card is capped at top.maxWidth points, its long lines ending in an ellipsis; the chronicle drawer is chronicle.width points wide and at most chronicle.height of the screen tall; a town card not pinned by its town stands on the left, townCard.width points wide; a toast is toast.width points wide.

close._: ui.gd close_x: the one close X on a card (town, house, court; CK3's and Total War's panel close): its square box's size, its inset from the card's top and right edges (the same both ways; Mac: 'this is not centered'), the X's width (centred in the box), and the least corner radius of its hover box, which is otherwise the card's own less the inset (concentric with the card's corner).
